correctness.rationale: For n=3m the initial blocks U,0^n,U with U=B0^mB suffice. At starts i<n the rightmost one is at n−1−i; at n the factor is zero; at starts n+r for 0<r≤2m the leftmost one is at n−r. For a cross comparison before 5m, i<m includes a one from the first B plus all the ones of the second B, whereas the right-side window takes only a prefix of B0^m. For i≥m the rightmost one is at most 2m−1, whereas the right-side window has a one at or beyond 2m: its first one for r≤m and its last one for m<r<2m. The last start to check, 5m, and the start m both give 0^mB0^m. Earlier distinctness makes m the unique earlier partner. Length one follows from 101. This proves the entire infinite family; the independent digit-generated rolling integer check uses exact factor encodings and reproduced each collision through k=8.
residual_risks: Finite corroboration does not extend the theorem to other lengths, other origins, or other morphisms.
